# netbox_ipam_role (Resource)

From the [official documentation](https://docs.netbox.dev/en/stable/features/ipam/#prefixvlan-roles):

> A role indicates the function of a prefix or VLAN. For example, you might define Data, Voice, and Security roles. Generally, a prefix will be assigned the same functional role as the VLAN to which it is assigned (if any).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "netbox_ipam_role" "test_basic" {
  name = "test"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the ipam role.

### Optional

- `comments` (String) Free-form comments about the ipam role. Needs NetBox 4.5.0 or later.
- `custom_fields` (Map of String) Custom field values of the object, as a map of field name to value.
- `description` (String) A description of the ipam role.
- `owner_id` (Number) The ID of the owner associated with the ipam role. Needs NetBox 4.5.0 or later.
- `slug` (String) The URL-friendly slug of the ipam role.
- `tags` (Set of String) Tags assigned to the object, by name.
- `weight` (Number) The weight of the ipam role.

### Read-Only

- `asn_count` (Number) The number of asn objects that refer to the ipam role.
- `created` (String) When the ipam role was created.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `last_updated` (String) When the ipam role was last changed.
- `prefix_count` (Number) The number of prefix objects that refer to the ipam role.
- `tags_all` (Set of String) All tags assigned to the object, including those not managed by Terraform.
- `vlan_count` (Number) The number of vlan objects that refer to the ipam role.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# The ID is the numeric NetBox ID of the object
terraform import netbox_ipam_role.example 1
```
